from collections import Counter
def transform(g):
    c=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    marker=min(c,key=c.get)
    g=[r[:] for r in g]
    for r in g:
        for j in range(len(r)-2):
            if r[j]==marker and r[j+1]!=marker and r[j+2]==marker:
                r[j+1]=2
    return g
print(transform(d1i)==d1o, transform(d2i)==d2o)
